summary: Checkout API errors were detected during the v2.18.0 deployment window and returned to baseline after rollback; the logs establish timing and impact counts, but not causality or final order/payment impact.

verified_facts.statement: Checkout API 5xx reached 14.8%; 312 failed checkout requests were counted in the alert window.

evidence.quote: [10:40:01] incident lead: 312 failed checkout requests in alert window

verified_facts.statement: Version v2.18.0 deployment completed at 10:05; rollback to v2.17.4 completed at 10:13; the dashboard reported baseline 5xx by 10:15.
The checkout writer pool was reported at 100% utilization while API requests timed out waiting for a connection.

evidence.quote:
[10:05:44] db-pool: checkout writer pool 100% utilized
[10:06:03] api-log: timeout waiting for connection (request_id=7f2a)
[10:06:19] api-log: timeout waiting for connection (request_id=7f31)

verified_facts.statement: The on-call initiated a rollback; the error rate and connection wait time declined afterward.

evidence.quote:
[10:09:56] on-call: starting rollback of checkout-api
[10:10:22] deploy-bot: rollback requested, target v2.17.4
[10:11:03] api-log: writer pool still 100% utilized
[10:11:44] incident chat: could be retries holding connections, unconfirmed
[10:12:30] status-page: checkout degraded, investigation ongoing
[10:13:02] deploy-bot: rollback to v2.17.4 completed
[10:13:28] dashboard: checkout 5xx 7.1%, trending down
[10:14:04] api-log: connection wait time declining

unverified_assumptions.statement: A change in v2.18.0 caused the connection-pool saturation.
unverified_assumptions.why_unverified: The release started before the alert but completed afterward; rollback preceded recovery, and no trace or code comparison confirms causality.

unverified_assumptions.statement: Every failed request corresponds to a failed order.
unverified_assumptions.why_unverified: The logs do not establish order outcomes for timed-out or retried requests.

residual_risks.statement: Duplicate or delayed order/payment outcomes remain unresolved while reconciliation is pending.

evidence.quote:
[10:31:15] payments: reconciliation still pending
[10:33:40] support: some users may have retried; order outcomes unclear
[10:54:20] payments: duplicate-capture query is still running
[10:57:10] on-call: leave root cause as unknown pending trace review

recommended_actions.action: Compare connection-pool metrics and request traces across v2.18.0 and v2.17.4.
Complete payment/order reconciliation and confirm whether retries created duplicate or delayed outcomes.

open_questions: What code or configuration change, if any, caused connection-pool saturation?
Did any timed-out or retried checkout create an order or duplicate capture?
What is the final count of affected users or unique orders?
